title: Two Palestinians Injured as Israeli Forces Raid Beit Imrin Again; Nablus Man Detained
detail: Two Palestinians were injured on August 18, 2026 after Israeli occupation soldiers assaulted them during a fresh raid on Beit Imrin, northwest of Nablus — two days after the village's home siege and mass arrest on August 16. The Palestine Red Crescent Society's director said ambulance crews treated the two for injuries sustained from beatings by Israeli soldiers and transported them to hospital. In a separate raid the same day in Nablus's al-Taawun area, Israeli forces detained a young man identified as Khalil Salibi.

title: Israeli Strike on Gaza City Port Cafe Targeting Nukhba Commanders Kills 6, Including a Child
detail: An Israeli strike hit a crowded cafe at the Gaza City port — an area that has become a displacement camp — on August 18, 2026, during what the IDF said was a meeting of Hamas's elite Nukhba force. The military said it targeted a Nukhba company commander, three platoon commanders, and other operatives it accused of 'planning attacks against Israeli troops operating in the Strip,' adding that at least one participant had taken part in the October 7, 2023 attack. Palestinian medics and the Shihab news agency said the strike killed six people, including a child, and wounded ten others; the intensity of the blast reportedly pushed some of the dead and injured into the sea, complicating recovery. The IDF said it took steps to minimize civilian harm and that verified strike results would be released later. Palestinian accounts described the site as a civilian cafe rather than a militant command post, a discrepancy that has recurred across the week's strikes.
